final.next_catalyst_and_timing: Ongoing operating results and execution on mobile/product strategy [D01, D03]

drivers.driver: The original governance catalyst is largely realized following board access and the appointment of a new CEO [D03, D07].
The core advertising business shows declining revenue ex-TAC and adjusted EBITDA, indicating the turnaround is not yet reflected in operating results [D03, D04].
Taking partial liquidity via the available block-trade terms allows us to lock in gains from the governance success while maintaining exposure to the Asian assets [D02, D04].
Continuing to hold the full position shifts our reliance from an event-driven thesis to a long-term operational growth bet, which carries higher execution risk [D04, D05].

final.memo:
Our investment in the Company began with a clear event-driven thesis: closing the gap between the sum-of-the-parts and the implied valuation through a governance intervention [D01, D08]. That catalyst has been realized with the successful appointment of a new CEO and our transition to board representation [D03, D07]. 

While the Asian assets continue to provide upside optionality, the core domestic advertising business is struggling, with Q2 revenue ex-TAC and adjusted EBITDA both down year-over-year [D03, D04]. We are not in the business of winning arguments or waiting indefinitely for a turnaround that remains unproven in the operating metrics [D03, D04]. 

With issuer block-liquidity terms available, we are electing to trim our position [D04]. This allows us to crystallize value from the successful governance campaign while rightsizing our exposure as the thesis evolves from an event-driven situation into an ongoing operational compounder [D02, D04].
